intro: UK Immigration Advisory gives regulated immigration advice in Warrington and across Cheshire. Speak to an adviser by phone or video call, send your documents online, and get your application checked before it’s submitted.
cardText: Regulated immigration advice for Warrington clients.

sections.heading: Immigration advice in Warrington, online or in person
sections.text:
Our advisers work with Warrington clients remotely, so there’s no need to travel for a consultation. We arrange a call or video meeting, send you a checklist, review your documents online and prepare your application. If you’d like to meet in person, our office is in Manchester city centre, at 61 Mosley Street.

UK Immigration Advisory is a trading name of Unique Visa Services Ltd, regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144, and advising clients since 2008.

sections.heading: What Warrington clients come to us for
sections.text:
Warrington sits right between Manchester and Liverpool, so it’s quick to reach our Manchester office if you’d like to meet in person. Much of our Warrington work is for local employers, especially in logistics, warehousing and engineering, who need a sponsor licence or help keeping on top of their sponsor duties.

Our main services include:
- [Spouse visa](/spouse-visa-uk/) applications and [extensions](/spouse-visa-extension/)
- [Skilled Worker visas](/skilled-worker-visa/) and the [Graduate visa](/graduate-visa/)
- [Indefinite Leave to Remain](/indefinite-leave-to-remain/) and [British citizenship](/british-citizenship/)
- [Sponsor licences](/sponsor-licence/) and [right to work checks](/right-to-work-checks/) for employers
- [Visa refusal help](/visa-refusal-help/) if things have gone wrong

sections.heading: Giving your biometrics in Warrington
sections.text: For biometrics, Warrington clients usually book at a service point in Manchester or Liverpool, whichever has the earliest appointment. After you apply online, we tell you which appointment to book and make sure your documents are ready. For many applications you can prove your identity with the UK Immigration: ID Check app instead, and we’ll tell you if that applies.

sections.heading: How to get started
sections.text:
Tell us a little about your situation by phone, WhatsApp or our [contact form](/contact-us/). We’ll arrange a consultation, usually within a few days, explain your options and the evidence you’ll need, and confirm our fee in writing before any work starts.

From there, you upload your documents, we prepare the application and check every page, and we stay in touch until you have a decision. It works the same for clients anywhere in Warrington and Cheshire.

sections.heading: What to expect from us
sections.text:
- Honest advice on whether you qualify, before you commit
- A fixed fee in writing, with no extra charge for being outside Manchester
- A personal checklist of the documents you need
- A full check of your forms and evidence against the current rules
- One adviser looking after your case from start to finish

sections.heading: Check your position for free
sections.text: Our free tools help you see where you stand before you speak to us: the [spouse visa calculator](/spouse-visa-calculator/), [UK visa fee calculator](/uk-visa-fee-calculator/), [ILR eligibility checker](/ilr-eligibility-checker/), [SOC code checker](/soc-code-checker/), [absence calculator](/absence-calculator/) and [Life in the UK practice test](/life-in-the-uk-practice-test/).

faqs.q: Can I get immigration advice in Warrington without travelling?
faqs.a: Yes. Consultations are by phone or video call, and documents are sent online or by post. You only travel for your biometrics appointment.

faqs.q: Do you charge more for Warrington clients?
faqs.a: No. Our fees are the same wherever you live, and agreed in writing before we start.

faqs.q: Where do Warrington applicants give biometrics?
faqs.a: For biometrics, Warrington clients usually book at a service point in Manchester or Liverpool, whichever has the earliest appointment.
Yes. We’re regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144. We’re not a law firm and aren’t connected to the Home Office.

faqs.q: Do you give immigration advice in Warrington for employers?
faqs.a: Yes. We help businesses apply for a sponsor licence, assign Certificates of Sponsorship and meet their sponsor duties.
